description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

John Deere is a company focused on addressing global challenges related to food, fiber, and infrastructure. They are seeking a Lab Test Engineer for Turf and Compact Utility Platforms to collect test data, automate tests, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Product testing engineer for automated test execution, data reporting, and root-cause analysis

Responsibilities:
• Collect test data, review with lead engineer and report results in the Vision system
• Identify innovative ways to automate tests, execute automated tests, communicate results, and involve cross-functional teams for root cause and resolution
• Learn and applies company engineering policies and practices

Requirements:
• 1 or more years experience working in the field
• 1 or more years experience in using software tools related to data analysis
• 1 or more years experience in product development process
• 1 or more years of understanding and applying engineering principles
• 1 or more years experience using computer aided design and/or engineering tools
• Effective communicator with teamwork experience
• Excellent technical writing & verbal communication skills
• Good analytical thinking and problem solving skills
• Ability and willingness to travel up to 25%
• Bachelor's and/or Master's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Ag, etc...) or equivalent experience

Preferred:
• Experience with PV&V data acquisition and analysis tools such as: National Instruments, eDAQs, nCode, Matlab, Morphee, etc…
• Programmable Logic Controller experience
• Test Laboratory experience
• Experience with SAE J1939 CAN analysis
• Problem resolution skills and diagnostics experience
• Compact Utility Tractor product experience
